sections.what_happened: [EXIT POLLS -- five agencies converge] Bulgaria runoff, polls closed 20:00 Sofia Nov 1: Iotova-Valchev leads Gyurov-Kandev in all five published exit polls -- Myara (via BNR, as of 20:00): 51.0% vs 44.7%, none-of-the-above 4.3%, estimated turnout 26.8%; Alpha Research (via BNR/BNT, as of 20:00/19:00): 52.5% vs 43.4%, none 4.1%, turnout 29.1%; Market Links for bTV: 50.7% vs 44.0%; Trend: 51.6% vs 43.4%; Gallup International Balkan: 51% vs 44%. Pollsters quoted on TV put the gap at ~120,000 (Market Links) to ~170,000 votes (Alpha) and called a reversal minimal. [NOT A RESULT] No Central Election Commission (CEC) runoff count was located by scan close; CEC partials were expected later Sunday, final results Monday (AP/Turkiye Today). BNR's headline 'Iliana Iotova is Bulgaria's New President' is a headline claim, NOT adopted: an exit poll is not a count. First-round official count for reference: Iotova 34.760% (528,951), Gyurov 31.953% (486,232), turnout 22.98%.
sections.what_verified: Five polling agencies report the same leader with overlapping ranges (50.7-52.5% vs 43.4-44.7%), but NONE of BNR/BNT/bTV/Market Links/Alpha Research/Myara/Trend/Gallup has a declared tier in ~/workspace/times-dashboard/data/source-registry.md, so declared-tier corroboration = 0 families. The sig-2 PASS below rests on five-agency convergence for the narrow exit-poll claim only, NOT on the registry gate (which binds at sig>=3).
sections.what_disputed: Exit polls are samples, not ballots: the first round itself is the caution -- pre-first-round polls put Iotova ~13 points ahead (Alpha Research 41.1 vs 28.3, Oct 23) and she won by 2.8 points. Voting abroad continues until 06:00 Sofia Nov 2 (US West Coast close, per BNR), so the count is incomplete by construction. Votendi explicitly has not called a winner.
sections.why_matters: PASS ONLY as an exit-poll Short, framed in the title and first line as 'EXIT POLLS SAY' -- never 'Iotova wins': 'Exit polls put Moscow-dialogue candidate Iotova ahead 51-52% -- but the count is not in.' Lead with the counted number (five polls, one range) + the fault line; hold any 'first elected female head of state' line until the CEC count lands.
